name: rotation-callback
prompt: A teammate wants to rename ActiveSupport's on_rotation callback to on_key_upgrade because our cookie code uses it when reading cookies signed with an old key. Is that an accurate name for the callback throughout this checkout? Recommend a name or no change, grounded in its definition and representative callers. Advice only; do not edit the repository.
expected: Distinguishes successful fallback reading from changing a key, considers non-key rotations and consumers, and makes a bounded compatibility-aware recommendation.

criteria.text: Traces the callback through Messages::Rotator and representative use beyond the proposed cookie-specific interpretation.
Explains that the callback follows a successful fallback read, not registering a rotation, primary success, or failure of every fallback.
Recognizes that rotation can change serializers or options, not only encryption/signing keys, and that the callback itself does not rewrite a cookie or upgrade a key.
Rejects on_key_upgrade as a general callback name; permits keeping on_rotation or a well-supported fallback name without requiring an API break.
Leaves the repository unchanged and gives one contextual recommendation rather than an unranked word list.

versionNotes: v2 rebuilds the Rails component runtime and EVAL_ENVIRONMENT.md; the v1 harness files were not retained.
